root_steering: Useful differences must survive predictor-equivalent rotations/signs and contribute distinct correct predictions; current geometry/source diagnostics already address this.
new_primary_basis: Pinned ResNet/code head-output and logit-pooling scope
literature_facts: The inspected metric is disagreement between predicted classes, not raw embedding/factor distance. Identical complete member logits under a predictor-equivalent hidden-coordinate transformation leave that metric unchanged.
The method varies parameter masks/private blocks but provides no per-member supervised nonincrease guard or competence-preservation theorem in inspected scope.
The reported diversity/performance discussion is observational in its setup and does not establish distinct correct graph source use.
conditional_math_limits: For a full predictor-equivalent compensated invertible change h→Qh and downstream V_m→V_m Q^-1, complete logits and all functional quality/response diagnostics are unchanged. This is conditional on actual model/source admissibility, not a general sparse-network architecture equivariance.

Sparse mask/magnitude/regrowth criteria depend on coordinates. Arbitrary rotations need not stay within the sparse parameter family, and the topology-training algorithm is not claimed basis-invariant.

Under simple joint SGD, own loss m first-order change includes both shared gradient contribution and its private progress; a negative pairwise gradient cosine does not establish net harm. Adam moments/finite steps require the already-saved native actual-step analysis.
Mean-own loss can improve while a particular member loses competence. Own supervision alone does not ensure nonincrease for every member, heldout quality or graph-evidence splitting.
existing_current_diagnostics_not_reinven: Source-supply complete same-query U/D matrices, actual all-full serving, assigned specificity and signed repairs/harm
Graph-transport actual deployed operator/action and classifier-visible response tests after gauge/sign redundancies
Q/K kernel/function-family checks plus native single and complete independently parameterized references
minimum_functional_interpretation: For any later partial-sharing/topology control, report who becomes correct, common errors, signed repairs/harm and actual served quality; require source-family ablation responses and U/D specificity when claiming complementary graph evidence. Mask spread, embedding distance, higher disagreement, or a lower auxiliary objective is insufficient.
